# Text

Functions over strings. Positions and lengths count UTF-16 code units, as in JavaScript. `includes`, `indexOf`, `replace`, and `replaceAll` match literal text; `matches` tests a regular expression.

Every function can be called as `f(x, ...)` or as a method, `x.f(...)`. In the signatures, `T` and `U` stand for any type, `T[]` is a list, `?` marks an optional parameter, and `(T, number) => boolean` is a lambda parameter.

| Function | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`toUpperCase`](#touppercase) | Upper-cases text. |
| [`toLowerCase`](#tolowercase) | Lower-cases text. |
| [`trim`](#trim) | Removes leading and trailing whitespace. |
| [`trimStart`](#trimstart) | Removes leading whitespace. |
| [`trimEnd`](#trimend) | Removes trailing whitespace. |
| [`startsWith`](#startswith) | Whether text starts with a prefix. |
| [`endsWith`](#endswith) | Whether text ends with a suffix. |
| [`includes`](#includes) | Whether text contains a substring, or a list contains a value. |
| [`indexOf`](#indexof) | Position of the first match, or -1. |
| [`lastIndexOf`](#lastindexof) | Position of the last match, or -1. |
| [`slice`](#slice) | A section of text or a list; negative positions count from the end. |
| [`split`](#split) | Splits text on a separator. |
| [`replace`](#replace) | Replaces the first occurrence of some text (no patterns). |
| [`replaceAll`](#replaceall) | Replaces every occurrence of some text (no patterns). |
| [`padStart`](#padstart) | Pads text at the start to a length. |
| [`padEnd`](#padend) | Pads text at the end to a length. |
| [`repeat`](#repeat) | Repeats text a number of times. |
| [`at`](#at) | The item or character at a position; negative positions count from the end. |
| [`matches`](#matches) | Whether text contains a match for a regular expression (JavaScript syntax without backreferences or lookaround, linear time; anchor with ^ and $; prefix (?i) to ignore case). |
| [`toString`](#tostring) | Renders a value as text, as a template would. |
| [`toNumber`](#tonumber) | Parses decimal text as a number, e.g. "-12.5" or "1e3" (surrounding whitespace is ignored; 0x and other bases are not accepted). |

## toUpperCase

Upper-cases text.

- `toUpperCase(string): string`

<!-- context: { items: [{ name: "Pen", price: 2, qty: 3 }, { name: "Book", price: 12, qty: 1 }, { name: "Bag", price: 30, qty: 1 }] } -->
```bonsai
"hello".toUpperCase() // => "HELLO"
```

## matches

Whether text contains a match for a regular expression (JavaScript syntax without backreferences or lookaround, linear time; anchor with ^ and $; prefix (?i) to ignore case).

- `matches(string, string): boolean`

<!-- context: { items: [{ name: "Pen", price: 2, qty: 3 }, { name: "Book", price: 12, qty: 1 }, { name: "Bag", price: 30, qty: 1 }] } -->
```bonsai
"INV-2041".matches("^INV-[0-9]+$") // => true
"Hello".matches("(?i)^hello$") // => true
"a.b".matches("a\\.b") // => true
```

## toString

Renders a value as text, as a template would.

- `toString(string | number | boolean | null | timestamp | duration): string`

<!-- context: { items: [{ name: "Pen", price: 2, qty: 3 }, { name: "Book", price: 12, qty: 1 }, { name: "Bag", price: 30, qty: 1 }] } -->
```bonsai

toString(null) // => ""

```

## toNumber

Parses decimal text as a number, e.g. "-12.5" or "1e3" (surrounding whitespace is ignored; 0x and other bases are not accepted).

- `toNumber(string | number): number`

<!-- context: { items: [{ name: "Pen", price: 2, qty: 3 }, { name: "Book", price: 12, qty: 1 }, { name: "Bag", price: 30, qty: 1 }] } -->
```bonsai
"42.5".toNumber() // => 42.5
" -1e3 ".toNumber() // => -1000
try("0x10".toNumber(), 0) // => 0
```
